## Environment

Operating system, Node.js and Python versions, and Docker version if used.

## Reproduction

Command and minimal sample. Remove credentials and private data.

## Expected and actual result

Include the failed step and a short console or report excerpt.

## Model and Android checks

State whether you used fixed responses or a live model, and whether Android ran or was skipped. For a device run, include the device and Android version.
